decisions.reason: As a space navigation and observation camera with its own product page, it fits the firm's proven optical guidance portfolio and should benefit from growing spacecraft and Earth observation demand.
The modular camera line is very close to the firm's core business, supports adaptable mission-specific sales, and its broader model range makes it strategically valuable to retain.

The space situational awareness sensor suite builds naturally on the firm's sensor and observation capabilities and is promising for future mission needs, even if it is somewhat newer and broader than its classic products.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor matches the firm's direction toward compact advanced sensors, but its lower website prominence suggests a somewhat earlier or more uncertain commercialization stage than the other launches.
